title: VPS upload service
help: Connect the independent upload service. Sign in to YouTube yourself in its remote browser.
urlHelp: The website connects to this private service address.
secretKept: Already set; leave blank to keep it
secretHelp: Use the uploader's shared secret (at least 32 characters). It is never shown again.
newSecretRequired: Enter the new service's secret when changing its URL.
desktopHelp: Use your protected desktop address or local SSH tunnel. The Google sign-in happens there.
saveBeforeTest: Save your changes before testing the connection.
refreshed: Latest settings loaded. Your unsaved edits have been kept; review them before saving.
failed: Could not complete the request. Try again.
conflict: The settings changed or the uploader is busy. Your edits are still here. Reload the saved settings and review the changes before saving again.
readOnly: You can view this configuration. Changing or testing it requires settings management permission.
loginNote: A successful connection test does not confirm Google sign-in. Open the remote desktop to check the account and channel.
openDesktop: Open remote desktop to sign in
